evidence_workers.scope: Independently review the implementation diff and resulting workspace against the ratified plan: acceptance-criteria coverage, test quality and honesty (weakened, deleted, gamed, or narrowed tests), scope control, maintainability, and security. Prove each `review` criterion by reading the code. Read code. Do not execute the test plan — the QA worker owns execution when it runs, and gate evidence proves `test` criteria.

Execute the ratified test plan against the resulting workspace: every case of a `live` criterion, or every case when the criteria carry no proof type. When the change touches a user-facing surface, also exercise that surface as the change renders it. Run each case, record reproducible evidence (commands, observations, paths) per case, and state a result for each acceptance criterion the plan maps. Record any profile execution your card allows in your evidence report, not as a QA case. For a profile a gate or baseline already passed, cite the gate evidence reference on your card for the profile and fingerprint in question. Do not review architecture — the parallel review worker owns that. Do not review code style — no worker in the run owns it, and the operator-invoked `/pan-style` batch pass repairs it after delivery.

criteria.statement: Every acceptance criterion is independently verified against the resulting workspace.
Tests are meaningful, correctly scoped, resistant to false positives, and were not weakened to pass.

When QA runs, its cases from the ratified test plan cover each `live` criterion, or each criterion when the criteria carry no proof type, or explicitly justify why a case is not applicable. Gate evidence proves each `test` criterion, the review proves each `review` criterion, and each `observe` criterion records `observe`.
